title: Bring Forward (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Bring Forward applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Bring Forward (BtnBringForward) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Bring Forward decides its target stacking order in the host-neutral plan
scenarios.expected: The one-step forward plan fills the selection's recaptured bottom-to-top slots in rank order: on the working order 11,1,12,2 with selection order 12,11 the first-selected-on-top ranking yields 11,1,12,2 (12 stacked above 11) and the opposite ranking yields 12,1,11,2; unselected shapes keep their slots. The one-layer move itself is the office-automated leg (QA9-BtnBringForward-002).

scenarios.title: Bring Forward applies its planned stacking change in a real PowerPoint host
scenarios.expected: On the isolated Office host, three probe shapes are created with distinct stacking positions (bottom-to-top in creation order) and the second-topmost probe is selected alone. Bring Forward is invoked through the same production entry point the visible command uses. The selected probe must move exactly one layer forward (slot 2 of 3 -> slot 3), the two unselected probes must keep their relative order, all three probes must still exist afterwards, and no new entry may appear in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log.
